task: RGB-only flooded-road segmentation with fixed SEG prefix
selection: Official train: all 162 positives + SHA256-ordered 138 negatives; official val: 30 positives + 50 negatives; official test: all 448 images. Fixed before inference.
training_sampling: 50% positive, 50% negative, replacement; shared seed gives same sample/augmentation sequence for head and first LoRA arm
scope: Segmentation adaptation with frozen image encoders, not free-form answer fine-tuning. Single Hurricane Harvey event. No test-based tuning.

module.name: RoadDetailAdapter
module.operations: 1x1 down, GELU, depthwise 3x3, GELU, zero-initialized 1x1 up, residual add

comparison: Isolated arm from original TerraScope weights; paired seed 20261015, same 1600 sample/augmentation sequence and 400 updates as head/module controls. Select on validation flooded-road IoU only.
optimization: Shared adapter features feed a 256-to-32-to-1 convolutional road head. All-road target is classes 3 OR 4. Add 0.3*(road BCE+Dice) and 0.05*mean(relu(p_flood-p_road)); road GT is used only for training and evaluation, never inference.
